paragraphs: Brooks Lee was the lone former Mustang to appear in a confirmed professional game on Saturday, batted second and started at third base for Minnesota Twins against Texas Rangers. Minnesota Twins fell to Texas Rangers, 2-6.
Brooks Lee produced a double in the third to right field on a 3-1 75 mph curveball from Nathan Eovaldi.
title: Brooks Lee represents Cal Poly in Saturday's pro action
